say:29:1826036002:1.text: Viscount Salazer, you and I are hardly acquainted. There's no need for such hollow pleasantries.
say:29:1826036002:1.source_cn: 斯莱泽先生，余和你没有私人交情。这个开场白未免太过俗套。

say:30:1826036003:1.text: It's true what they say about vampires having memories like steel traps.
say:30:1826036003:1.source_cn: 呵呵，身为吸血鬼的您，记忆力还是那么出众。

say:31:1826036004:1.text: What brings you to Novaris? It's terribly rude to disturb a lady during her rest.
say:31:1826036004:1.source_cn: 此番前来诺珐斯，所为何事？打搅淑女的休息时间，可是一件...

say:32:1826036005:1.text: King Thoran heard of the recent unrest in Novaris, so he sent me to inspect the situation... or rather, to offer whatever assistance I can.
say:32:1826036005:1.source_cn: 陛下听闻诺珐斯戒严，连日来动荡不安，所以特意派遣我前来...

say:33:1826036006:1.text: Anyway, I noticed the lockdown had been lifted when I passed through town earlier, though a few streets were still teeming with questionable characters. I take it everything has been sorted out?

say:35:1826036007:1.text: Naturally. Is His Majesty questioning my ability to handle something so trivial?

say:37:1826036010:1.text: As far as I know, the information came from Grezhul and his guards.
say:37:1826036010:1.source_cn: 据我所知，这些消息来自于格瑞泽尔勒所率领的禁卫军。

say:38:1826036011:0.text: 哦，对了，他们还说……<u><link=Case><style=highlight>您和格瑞泽尔勒一样，在一场爆炸中受了重伤</style></link></u>。

say:43:1826036015:1.text: I suppose His Majesty has also heard about the Refinery's destruction.
say:43:1826036015:1.source_cn: 既然如此，想必陛下也听说了炼化间被毁一事吧。

say:44:1826036016:1.text: I would think the Soul Forge warrants more attention than my health, does it not?
say:44:1826036016:1.source_cn: 比起余之健康，亡灵转化器才是更为紧要之事，不是吗？

say:45:1826036017:1.text: Precisely, and His Majesty was livid. Countless people were tortured in the wake of his fury, and the palace was strewn with severed limbs and mangled remains...
say:45:1826036017:1.source_cn: 没错。得知转化器毁坏，陛下震怒不已。无数人受刑，王宫到...

say:48:1826036019:1.source_cn: 余不想知道你的特殊癖好，住嘴吧。

say:49:1826036020:1.text: What a shame... I thought only vampires could appreciate my tastes. Apparently, I was mistaken.
say:49:1826036020:1.source_cn: 真遗憾……我一直以为，唯有高贵的吸血鬼能够理解我。看来...

say:4:1826034001:1.text: If you're ready, we can invite Salazer in.
say:4:1826034001:1.source_cn: 如果一切准备就绪，我就让仆人们将斯莱泽请入庄园了。
say:4:1826034001:1.male: If you're ready, we can invite Salazer in.
say:4:1826034001:1.female: If you're ready, we can invite Salazer in.

say:50:1826036024:1.text: Now, back to the matter at hand.

say:51:1826036025:1.text: Has the one responsible for the Refinery's destruction been brought to justice? And that explosion... has its cause been determined?

say:52:1826036026:1.source_cn: 要是您的下属太过怠惰，我可以替您向陛下修书一封，请求调...

say:54:1826036027:1.text: The perpetrator didn't cover their tracks particularly well. In fact, one of my servants was just informing me that the investigation had reached its conclusion.
say:54:1826036027:1.source_cn: 破坏炼化间的犯人留下了不少线索。方才仆人还在向余汇报，...

say:55:1826036028:1.text: Your visit came at a rather inconvenient time, and so I was forced to set the matter aside.
say:55:1826036028:1.source_cn: 只是好巧不巧，你要拜见余。所以余只能暂且搁置此事。

say:56:1826036029:1.text: Oh? What a coincidence. By all means, have your servant present their findings now. May I listen in?
say:56:1826036029:1.source_cn: 哦？真是巧啊。那便请您的仆人现在来汇报吧。如果您不介意...

say:57:1826036030:1.text: If I were to refuse, I suppose you'd question my loyalty to Bantus, just as Grezhul did.
say:57:1826036030:1.source_cn: 若是余拒绝，恐怕你也要像格瑞泽尔勒卿一样，怀疑余对班题...

say:5:1826034002:1.text: As you quickly go over the questions Salazer might ask, something important suddenly comes to mind—the destruction of the Refinery.
say:5:1826034002:1.source_cn: 你飞快地在脑海里梳理了一遍班题斯贵族可能询问的问题，猛...
say:5:1826034002:1.male: As you quickly go over the questions Salazer might ask, something important suddenly comes to mind—the destruction of the Refinery.
say:5:1826034002:1.female: As you quickly go over the questions Salazer might ask, something important suddenly comes to mind—the destruction of the Refinery.

say:63:1826036034:1.text: Have you identified who destroyed the Refinery?
say:63:1826036034:1.source_cn: 破坏炼化间的罪人，查清是谁了吗？

say:64:1826036035:1.text: Yes, Your Ladyship. The culprit is <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a worker at the Repair House.
say:64:1826036035:1.source_cn: 回禀领主阁下，已经查清。犯人是修缮屋的员工，名为<st...
say:64:1826036035:1.male: Yes, Your Ladyship. The culprit is <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a worker at the Repair House.
say:64:1826036035:1.female: Yes, Your Ladyship. The culprit is <style="stress"><player_name></style>, a worker at the Repair House.

say:65:1826036036:1.text: The name is merely an alias. He's actually a Lightbearer mage who sneaked into Bantus, posing as a fan of Senea.
say:65:1826036036:1.source_cn: 根据我们的调查，这其实是个化名。<male>他</ma...
say:65:1826036036:1.male: The name is merely an alias. He's actually a Lightbearer mage who sneaked into Bantus, posing as a fan of Senea.
say:65:1826036036:1.female: The name is merely an alias. She's actually a Lightbearer mage who sneaked into Bantus, posing as a fan of Senea.

say:66:1826036037:1.text: The investigation into how and why he committed the crime is still ongoing. However, we suspect he was acting on behalf of the Lightbearer royal family.
say:66:1826036037:1.source_cn: 作案动机和手法还在调查。我们怀疑<male>他</ma...
say:66:1826036037:1.male: The investigation into how and why he committed the crime is still ongoing. However, we suspect he was acting on behalf of the Lightbearer royal family.
say:66:1826036037:1.female: The investigation into how and why she committed the crime is still ongoing. However, we suspect she was acting on behalf of the Lightbearer royal family.

say:6:1826034003:1.text: With the Soul Forge wrecked, Thoran is unlikely to let the matter slide. Chances are, Salazer was sent here to hold Tephesia accountable.
say:6:1826034003:1.source_cn: 亡灵转化器被毁，骸骨之王肯定不会善罢甘休。这次派贵族前...

say:70:1826036039:1.text: Repair House... This isn't the first time I've heard of that place.
say:70:1826036039:1.source_cn: 修缮屋……又是这个地方啊。

say:71:1826036040:1.text: Grezhul's guards told me that the Refinery was attacked not long after they arrived in Novaris. Interestingly, the culprit was also from the Repair House.
say:71:1826036040:1.source_cn: 格瑞泽尔勒手下的禁卫军告诉过我，他们刚抵达诺珐斯没多久...

say:72:1826036041:1.text: That Repair House is quite the den of hidden talent... wouldn't you agree, Lady Tephesia?
say:72:1826036041:1.source_cn: 这可真是一个卧虎藏龙的地方……我说的对吗，苔佩希小姐？

say:74:1826036042:1.text: Why would I know anything more about it? If you want details, you should take it up with Grezhul's guards.
say:74:1826036042:1.source_cn: 既然你是从禁卫军口中得知的，那么就该向他们确认。何必来问余？

say:76:1826036045:1.text: Anyway, His Majesty expects this matter to be resolved without delay. I trust you'll have the culprit apprehended in due course.
say:76:1826036045:1.source_cn: 那么还请尽快抓捕犯人，给托安陛下一个交代。

say:77:1826036046:1.text: By the way, I understand vampires have a custom of keeping the living as blood thralls. I've handpicked a few of my finest pets as a gift for you.
say:77:1826036046:1.source_cn: 对了，听闻吸血鬼会豢养生者作为血仆。我从我的宠物中挑选...

say:78:1826036047:1.text: Pets... The way Salazer refers to the living makes your hair stand on end. You shudder to imagine how he treats them.
say:78:1826036047:1.source_cn: 宠物……斯莱泽对生者的称呼令你不寒而栗。你甚至不敢细想...
say:78:1826036047:1.male: Pets... The way Salazer refers to the living makes your hair stand on end. You shudder to imagine how he treats them.
say:78:1826036047:1.female: Pets... The way Salazer refers to the living makes your hair stand on end. You shudder to imagine how he treats them.

say:79:1826036048:1.text: Eryndor's reminder rings clear in your mind—Tephesia doesn't like keeping blood thralls, and there are none left at Mortimer Manor.
say:79:1826036048:1.source_cn: 无论如何，你始终记得埃德加的嘱咐——苔佩希不喜欢血仆，...
say:79:1826036048:1.male: Eryndor's reminder rings clear in your mind—Tephesia doesn't like keeping blood thralls, and there are none left at Mortimer Manor.
say:79:1826036048:1.female: Eryndor's reminder rings clear in your mind—Tephesia doesn't like keeping blood thralls, and there are none left at Mortimer Manor.

say:7:1826034004:1.text: Thane, Baden, and the others have all left Novaris. You will now need a new scapegoat to take the fall and quell Bantus' suspicion.
say:7:1826034004:1.source_cn: 瑟恩、巴登等人都已离开诺珐斯，你需要给出一位新的“犯人...
say:7:1826034004:1.male: Thane, Baden, and the others have all left Novaris. You will now need a new scapegoat to take the fall and quell Bantus' suspicion.
say:7:1826034004:1.female: Thane, Baden, and the others have all left Novaris. You will now need a new scapegoat to take the fall and quell Bantus' suspicion.

say:81:1826036049:1.text: I appreciate your kind gesture, but I have no need for blood thralls. I sent them all away long ago.
say:81:1826036049:1.source_cn: 多谢你的好意，但不必了。余不需要血仆侍奉，早已将他们全...

say:82:1826036050:1.text: King Thoran loathes the presence of the living in Bantus. I'd advise you to keep your pets out of his sight.
say:82:1826036050:1.source_cn: 何况托安陛下最厌恶班题斯境内有生者来往。小心你的宠物会...

say:83:1826036051:1.text: Heh... Thanks for your concern. I'll keep that in mind.
say:83:1826036051:1.source_cn: 呵……多谢您的提醒，我一定牢记。

say:84:1826036052:1.text: Now, it's about time I take my leave. I have a <style="highlight">banquet to attend</style>. A friend in Novaris was kind enough to invite me.
say:84:1826036052:1.source_cn: 我在诺珐斯的朋友邀请我前去<style=highlig...

say:85:1826036053:1.text: I look forward to seeing you at the palace next time, Lady Tephesia. I'm sure it will be... most delightful.
say:85:1826036053:1.source_cn: 期待下一次能在王宫中见到您的身影。那一定会是……非常美...

say:87:1826036043:1.text: Who knows? It's possible that the Lightbearer mage made someone else at the Repair House take the fall.
say:87:1826036043:1.source_cn: 又或许，是那个魔法师栽赃到修缮屋其他人身上的。谁能说得准呢？

say:88:1826036021:1.text: *Yawn*... Of all the Bantus nobles I've met, I'm sorry to say you bore me the most.
say:88:1826036021:1.source_cn: 哈啊……在余认识的班题斯贵族之中，你可谓是说话最无趣的那个。

say:89:1826036022:1.text: You certainly know how to cut a person down with words, Lady Tephesia.
say:89:1826036022:1.source_cn: 呵，苔佩希小姐的尖牙利嘴果然不饶人。

say:8:1826034005:1.text: <style="highlight">The perfect candidate is none other than you</style>, a mysterious mage with extraordinary power. After destroying the Refinery, you went on to blow up the Adamant Syndicate's building in Novaris.
say:8:1826034005:1.male: <style="highlight">The perfect candidate is none other than you</style>, a mysterious mage with extraordinary power. After destroying the Refinery, you went on to blow up the Adamant Syndicate's building in Novaris.
say:8:1826034005:1.female: <style="highlight">The perfect candidate is none other than you</style>, a mysterious mage with extraordinary power. After destroying the Refinery, you went on to blow up the Adamant Syndicate's building in Novaris.

say:90:1826036023:1.text: My apologies. I've wandered too far off the subject.

say:91:1826036008:1.text: Unrest? Novaris has known nothing but peace under my rule. I'm afraid His Majesty's sources are unreliable.
say:91:1826036008:1.source_cn: 动荡不安？在余统治之下的诺珐斯，怎么可能动荡不安？你应...

say:9:1826034006:1.text: To keep up this charade, you will need a reliable servant to back you up...
say:9:1826034006:1.source_cn: 为了演好这出戏，你还需要一个可靠的仆人从旁协助……
say:9:1826034006:1.male: To keep up this charade, you will need a reliable servant to back you up...
